mock_data.description: Intelligent MCP controller for Nokia SROS BNG state and availability. Provides metrics, logs, health assessment, and engineering SME context for Broadband Network Gateway operations.

capabilities.name: bng://manifest
capabilities.description: Controller manifest with capabilities and dependencies

capabilities.name: bng://namespaces
capabilities.description: All Kubernetes namespaces visible to the controller — useful for discovering where BNG target CRs may live

capabilities.name: bng://targets
capabilities.description: All monitored BNG targets (devices and hosts) — name, address, hostname, kind, namespace

capabilities.name: bng_targets_by_label
capabilities.description: Monitored BNG targets filtered by Kubernetes label selector, e.g. `role=bng` or `env=prod,role=bng`

capabilities.name: bng://targets/devices
capabilities.description: All NetworkDeviceTarget CRs with full spec and status

capabilities.name: bng://targets/devices/{namespace}
capabilities.description: NetworkDeviceTarget CRs filtered by Kubernetes namespace

capabilities.name: bng://targets/hosts
capabilities.description: All NetworkHostTarget CRs with full spec and status

capabilities.name: bng://targets/hosts/{namespace}
capabilities.description: NetworkHostTarget CRs filtered by Kubernetes namespace

capabilities.name: bng://health/summary
capabilities.description: Real-time overall BNG health status — aggregated across all metric categories (CPU, memory, SRRP, FP resources, subscribers). To be implemented.

capabilities.name: read_bng_manifest
capabilities.description: Read the full BNG controller manifest including identity, capabilities, dependencies, and data sources

capabilities.name: discover_bng_capabilities
capabilities.description: Discover all BNG capabilities grouped by kind (resource, resource_template, tool, prompt)

capabilities.name: read_bng_resource
capabilities.description: Read any registered BNG resource by its `bng://` URI — supports static resources and parameterized templates

capabilities.name: bng_device_unavailability_map
capabilities.description: Check whether a BNG device was unreachable during a time window using absent_over_time() on CPU telemetry. Supports an optional start_time for historical queries.

capabilities.name: bng_device_cpu_usage
capabilities.description: Query CPU usage time series for a BNG device over a time window with summary statistics (avg, min, max) and quantiles (p80, p95, p98). Supports an optional start_time for historical queries.

capabilities.name: bng_device_memory_usage
capabilities.description: Query memory utilization (%) time series for a BNG device over a time window with summary statistics (avg, min, max) and quantiles (p80, p95, p98). Supports an optional start_time for historical queries.

capabilities.name: bng_device_hosts_stats
capabilities.description: Return peak and current IPv4/IPv6 subscriber host counts for a BNG device using instant queries on `state_subscriber_mgmt_statistics_total_hosts_peak_value` and `state_subscriber_mgmt_statistics_total_hosts_current_value`.

capabilities.name: bng-overview
capabilities.description: Session bootstrap prompt — returns the BNG controller manifest and grouped capability summary so the LLM knows what is available
